commit.message:
feat(edm): generic ISO-style sinker post, every EDM code from the machine's edm.codes

assets/posts/sinker-iso.cps ("Sinker EDM (ISO)") writes the RS-274
words itself (G0, G90, the work offset, comments) and every EDM code
from the .mch edm.codes / edm.orbits (#290 D5): the unit word, pickup
{tool}, reference {offset}, condition {id}, the burn to depth {z} {f},
the end, and a stated orbit's word {radius}. A missing code, an unfilled
placeholder or a value the program does not state refuses the post by
name. A feed with X/Y travel, a feed up, an arc, a cycle, compensation,
an rpm or a coolant ask is refused by name.

edm.codes is parsed as role -> non-empty template (garbage refuses the
file by role). The mirror and the raw door carry a wire/sinker machine's
kind and edm section into the script. The engine's serves law: a script
declaring serves = "sinker_edm" posts for sinkers only, and a wire or
sinker EDM refuses every script that does not declare its kind - so
every mill, lathe and plasma post stays refused on a sinker, for the
app, the CLI and user scripts alike. post_serves / default_post_for list
it for sinker EDMs. A Sinker Burn's stream carries PARAM EdmCondition
and ElectrodePickup.

Goldens nc/sinker-iso/ against the synthetic fixture dialect
crates/app/tests/edm/sinker-iso-dialect.mch: the recorded CL posted
from the post crate, and the real op through post_setup. Docs:
assets/posts/AGENTS.md, assets/machines/AGENTS.md, CNC-INTERMEDIATE.
PROCESS_VERSION 23 (renumbers at merge). Follow-up: #1135.

Not exercised on a real EDM control.

Fixes #542

moves to script_sinker_iso.rs and gains post_suite!("sinker-iso.cps").
The nine recorded mill cases post machine-less, so each golden is the
post's named refusal ("serves sinker_edm machines only"); the sinker's
own stream (the Sinker Burn CL golden wrapped as the dump wraps it)
posts through the binary on the fixture dialect to
recorded/golden/sinker-iso/sinker_burn_cavity.nc, byte-identical to
app's nc/sinker-iso golden. recorded::verdict_on / compare split out of
verdict / check for a stream and machine other than the mill cases'.
All goldens written by the suite's own WRITE_GOLDEN path.

solid_law_goldens::every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes:
sinker_burn_cavity.nc is now judged, not exempted - box_atom_verdicts()
generates the real Sinker Burn op on a sinker over a block whose cavity
is the electrode grown by the gap, proves its program is the CL golden
byte for byte, and runs stock_sim::simulate_document (the program
verdict with the electrode's box atom): 0 gouge cells. A 5 mm cavity
convicts 432 cells (checked by hand), so the judge bites. No law loosened.

feat(edm): sinker post rides main's serves door; orbit, side burn and an unlisted condition refused by name

- sinker-iso.cps declares serves = ["sinker_edm"] (main's manifest,
  #1266) and reads its condition from PARAM SinkerCondition (main's
  EdmCondition is the wire section's word, refused through any script
  without wireEdm). It refuses by name a condition the machine's
  edm.conditions does not list, an orbit (#544: its explicit moves are
  what the stock sim judged; never swapped for the control's orbit
  word), and a Sinker Side Burn (#545). orbitWord() is gone.
- posting_edm.rs: SinkerCondition and ElectrodePickup for both sinker
  op kinds, plus EdmOrbit / EdmOrbitRadius for an orbit.
- posting_family::edm_at_post ("no post for a sinker EDM machine yet")
  retired: the sinker post ships, and every writer's serves door
  (posting_serves) refuses any post that does not serve a sinker.
